items.headline: Sources: Vikings made initial Kirk Cousins trade call to Raiders before MNF
items.description: The Vikings initially reached out to the Raiders about a Kirk Cousins trade before their MNF game against the Bills, sources told ESPN and NFL Network.

items.headline: Despite Cousins trade, are Vikings back to square one at QB?
items.description: Cousins can give some short-term relief, but his future and the search for a franchise QB remain uncertain.

items.headline: T.J. Hockenson unlikely to play Sunday vs. the Packers
items.description: Kevin Seifert reports Hockenson's absence would be a significant loss for Kirk Cousins and the Vikings.

items.headline: Vikings to start reacquired QB Kirk Cousins vs. Packers
items.description: Coach Kevin O'Connell called Kirk Cousins' ability to get reacquainted with the Vikings' offense "impressive."
